title: GenAI-integrated data structures and algorithms homework
summary: CS2 students complete six individual programming homeworks and a distinct GenAI activity in each one. Tasks include comparing AI and student solutions, AI-assisted debugging and optimization, and validating AI-generated implementations or algorithm ideas.

sources.title: Integrating Generative AI with Data Structures and Algorithm Analysis Course Homework
sources.evidence_quote: The redesigned course homework was composed of three components: 80% Data structures and algorithms implementation; 10% Program testing; 10% Exploiting generative AI.

assessment.summary: Implement and test data structures and algorithms, then complete an assigned GenAI comparison, debugging, optimization, generation, or validation activity.
student_actions: Implement required algorithms and data structures individually.
Use GenAI for the specified activity.
Compare, verify, or summarize the AI output in at least 50 words.

student_role.description: Students must use a GenAI system for a designated activity and compare or validate its output.

grading.method: Each redesigned homework allocates 80% to implementation, 10% to testing, and 10% to GenAI use.

reported_results: 85.1% agreed or strongly agreed that GenAI helped them understand testing and debugging.
74.5% agreed or strongly agreed that GenAI helped with efficient data-structure and algorithm implementation.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.
